title: Mystic Shore Aurora
description: A hooded figure in a long patterned cloak stands on a beach covered in glowing colorful circles and constellation symbols, raising one hand toward a glowing sailboat floating on the ocean. The night sky blazes with a vibrant green and purple aurora borealis, constellations, and shooting stars.
prompt: A hooded figure in a long dark blue patterned cloak stands on a beach at night, raising one hand toward a glowing sailboat on the calm ocean. The beach is covered in overlapping colorful glowing circles and black constellation symbols of animals and figures. Dramatic green and purple aurora borealis fills the sky with visible constellations and shooting stars, whimsical fantasy style, magical atmosphere
